[HIGH] DB_FAILURE
subject: SYSTEM
reason: DB_FAILURE
at: 2026-10-09T03:00:00Z
What happened: A database read or write the safety path depends on failed, or the stored day state is missing or unreadable (DB_FAILURE; the reason code is the SAFE_MODE reason, DAY_STATE_MISSING or DAY_STATE_UNREADABLE).
Position: A position may be open. This message does not say whether it is protected, and the local records may be incomplete.
System already did: New entries are blocked while the problem lasts. Nothing was cancelled or re-sent because of this message; stops and take profits are not touched.
You must: Check the database and the journal using the reason code, and check the exchange positions and orders directly until the records are healthy again.
